lowered_because: 71 tail candidates from the #686 sweep - 65 seeding the preliminary language_specific_datasets category, and 6 language-specific but not low-resource candidates routed to benchmark_eval_data and training_synthetic_datasets - introduced candidate-org slugs ahead of their handles: a tail row names its org but declares no handle until promotion, so the github, huggingface and homepage_domain denominators grow while the numerators do not. No handle was removed and no existing mapping regressed. The 51 new orgs - among them ai4bharat, ai-singapore, masakhane, mozilla-foundation, open-language-data-initiative, seacrowd, hitz, mbzuai, linguistic-data-consortium and te-hiku-media - get handles at promotion, which is when the numerator catches up.
